author: mira
title: Reminders fire twice after the clocks change
body:
Since the clocks went forward on Sunday every reminder in my calendar fires twice, one hour apart.
I am on version 2.3 of the desktop app and it happens with every calendar I have.
Is there a setting I missed, or is this a bug in how reminders handle the time change?

author: jon
title: Reminders fire twice after the clocks change
body:
Thanks for the report. I can reproduce this on 2.3 with any reminder created before the change.
The scheduler stores the reminder time twice when the offset moves, so this is a bug on our side.

author: jon
title: Reminders fire twice after the clocks change
body:
The fix for the doubled reminders is merged and goes out in version 2.4 this week.
After updating, open the app once so that the scheduler can rebuild its list of reminders.

author: olu
title: Allow a different colour for each shared calendar
body:
It would help a great deal to give each shared calendar its own colour in the week view.
Right now every shared calendar is shown in the same grey, which makes a busy week hard to read.
